newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs weaker, but support seen at 126.70.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs weaker, but support seen at 126.70.

text.p: The key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract is likely to ease on Wednesday after it failed to stay above 127 in London on Tuesday after closing in Tokyo at 127.00.
It ended at 126.93 in London. Traders say the contract's downside will be limited at around 126.70-126.80.

"It might try the downside today in Tokyo after the London close of below 127.00. But a sharp fall, say of more than one yen or 0.50 yen, is unlikely because bargain-hunting demand for cash bonds is strong on dips," said a securities house dealer.
Some traders said that if it confirms a solid bottom, the June may test an all-time high of 127.34 recorded on Tuesday.

"The contract has room to rise as high as 127.50 because sentiment is still basically bullish given good sales of recently launched corporate straight bonds and 20-year JGBs," said a dealer at a Big-Four brokerage house.
But some others said the contract may meet a resistance point at around 127.30.
"Those who bought when the June rose to the 127.20-127.30 level are likely to take profits. Such selling may keep the contract from rising further," the first dealer said.
